# Background: 
# Gauss-Seidel is an iterative method for solving linear systems Ax=b. The method is based on 
# decomposing the matrix A into A = M - N, where M = D - L (D is diagonal, L is lower triangular).
# The iterative formula is: x^(k+1) = M^(-1) * N * x^(k) + M^(-1) * b
# In component form: x_i^(k+1) = (b_i - sum_{j<i} a_ij*x_j^(k+1) - sum_{j>i} a_ij*x_j^(k)) / a_ii
# This means we use the most recently computed values (from current iteration) for j<i and 
# old values (from previous iteration) for j>i. The method converges when A is diagonally dominant
# or symmetric positive definite. We iterate until ||x_k - x_{k-1}||_2 < eps.

def GS(A, b, eps, x_true, x0):
    '''Solve a given linear system Ax=b using Gauss-Seidel iteration
    Input
    A:      N by N matrix, 2D array
    b:      N by 1 right hand side vector, 1D array
    eps:    Float number indicating error tolerance
    x_true: N by 1 true solution vector, 1D array
    x0:     N by 1 zero vector, 1D array
    Output
    residual: Float number shows L2 norm of residual (||Ax - b||_2)
    error:    Float number shows L2 norm of error vector (||x-x_true||_2) 
    '''
    
    A = np.array(A, dtype=float)
    b = np.array(b, dtype=float)
    x_true = np.array(x_true, dtype=float)
    x = np.array(x0, dtype=float)
    
    n = len(b)
    
    # Gauss-Seidel iteration
    while True:
        x_old = x.copy()
        
        # Update each component using Gauss-Seidel formula
        for i in range(n):
            sum_lower = np.dot(A[i, :i], x[:i])  # sum_{j<i} a_ij * x_j^(k+1)
            sum_upper = np.dot(A[i, i+1:], x_old[i+1:])  # sum_{j>i} a_ij * x_j^(k)
            x[i] = (b[i] - sum_lower - sum_upper) / A[i, i]
        
        # Check convergence: ||x_k - x_{k-1}||_2 < eps
        increment_norm = np.linalg.norm(x - x_old)
        if increment_norm < eps:
            break
    
    # Calculate residual: ||Ax - b||_2
    residual = np.linalg.norm(np.dot(A, x) - b)
    
    # Calculate error: ||x - x_true||_2
    error = np.linalg.norm(x - x_true)
    
    return residual, error

# The iterative formula is: x^(k+1) = M^(-1) * N * x^(k) + M^(-1) * b
# In component form: x_i^(k+1) = (b_i - sum_{j<i} a_ij*x_j^(k+1) - sum_{j>i} a_ij*x_j^(k)) / a_ii
# This means we use the most recently computed values (from current iteration) for j<i and 
# old values (from previous iteration) for j>i. The method converges when A is diagonally dominant
# or symmetric positive definite. We iterate until ||x_k - x_{k-1}||_2 < eps.

def GS(A, b, eps, x_true, x0):
    '''Solve a given linear system Ax=b using Gauss-Seidel iteration
    Input
    A:      N by N matrix, 2D array
    b:      N by 1 right hand side vector, 1D array
    eps:    Float number indicating error tolerance
    x_true: N by 1 true solution vector, 1D array
    x0:     N by 1 zero vector, 1D array
    Output

    error:    Float number shows L2 norm of error vector (||x-x_true||_2) 
    '''
    
    A = np.array(A, dtype=float)
    b = np.array(b, dtype=float)
    x_true = np.array(x_true, dtype=float)
    x = np.array(x0, dtype=float)
    
    n = len(b)
    
    # Gauss-Seidel iteration
    while True:
        x_old = x.copy()
        
        # Update each component using Gauss-Seidel formula
        for i in range(n):
            sum_lower = np.dot(A[i, :i], x[:i])  # sum_{j<i} a_ij * x_j^(k+1)
            sum_upper = np.dot(A[i, i+1:], x_old[i+1:])  # sum_{j>i} a_ij * x_j^(k)
            x[i] = (b[i] - sum_lower - sum_upper) / A[i, i]
        
        # Check convergence: ||x_k - x_{k-1}||_2 < eps
        increment_norm = np.linalg.norm(x - x_old)
        if increment_norm < eps:
            break
    
    # Calculate residual: ||Ax - b||_2
    residual = np.linalg.norm(np.dot(A, x) - b)
    
    # Calculate error: ||x - x_true||_2
    error = np.linalg.norm(x - x_true)
    
    return residual, error
